sources.title: Lithium polymer batteries
sources.locator_notes: Direct HTTPS HTML: exact Type rows and capacity; Technical info describes soft/pouch cells. The unqualified page capacities equal selected PDF Minimum values. LP503759JU download tooltip incorrectly names LP502030JH, but its Type row and the opened linked PDF both identify LP503759JU; the tooltip is not identity evidence. No globally latest edition is assumed.
